mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_reminder_delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT FROM crm_reminder_delivery WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND scheduled_at <= #{scheduledBefore} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY scheduled_at

SELECT d.delivery_id, d.tenant_id, d.plan_id, d.customer_id, d.plan_key, d.planned_follow_up_at, d.scheduled_at, d.recipient_user_id, d.recipient_name, d.status, d.retry_count, d.last_attempt_at, d.last_error_code, d.completed_at, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.version, d.del_flag, c.name AS customer_name FROM crm_reminder_delivery d LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id AND c.del_flag = '0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND d.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING', 'SENT') AND d.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY d.planned_follow_up_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_reminder_delivery ( delivery_id, tenant_id, plan_id, customer_id, plan_key, planned_follow_up_at, scheduled_at, recipient_user_id, recipient_name, status, retry_count, last_attempt_at, last_error_code, completed_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{deliveryId}, #{tenantId}, #{planId}, #{customerId}, #{planKey}, #{plannedFollowUpAt}, #{scheduledAt}, #{recipientUserId}, #{recipientName}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{lastAttemptAt}, #{lastErrorCode}, #{completedAt}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW(), 0, '0' )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_reminder_delivery SET status = #{status}, last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_reminder_delivery SET status = 'RETRYING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_attempt_at = #{lastAttemptAt}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND delivery_id = #{deliveryId} AND retry_count < 3 AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_reminder_delivery SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_reminder_delivery SET status = 'CANCELLED', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYING') AND del_flag = '0'
